key_insight: Train an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, enabling label-free learning of coupled thermo-fluid fields on meshes.
engineering_relevance: This reduces CFD data generation and storage costs while preserving physically consistent predictions for steady and transient thermo-fluid surrogates.
method: Compute FVM residuals of the governing equations on the mesh as the training loss.
Use an attention graph neural network to learn 3D coupled thermo-fluid behavior without labeled snapshots.
Compare against CFD references and a data-supervised baseline across four benchmark scenarios.
evidence_signal: Across four cases, the FVM-loss model achieved 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on the steady benchmarks and outperformed the supervised baseline on the transient parametric cases.
watch_item: Residual-based training still depends on mesh quality and accurate discretization of the governing equations, so poor numerical setup could weaken physical fidelity.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
